newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-ATHERTON MISSES ONE-DAYER AGAINST NEW ZEALAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ATHERTON MISSES ONE-DAYER AGAINST NEW ZEALAND.

text.p: England captain Mike Atherton was omitted from the team for Sunday's second one-day international against New Zealand because of a slight back injury.
New Zealand won the toss and batted first.
New Zealand - Bryan Young, Nathan Astle, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Chris Cairns, Lee Germon (captain), Chris Harris, Dipak Patel, Gavin Larsen, Simon Doull, Heath Davis.
England - Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain (captain), Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Ronnie Irani, Dominic Cork, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Alan Mullally, Andrew Caddick.
